name: Arms for the Field
label: Quest
description: Arms for the Field: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for additional weapons that we haven't been able to provide at the moment. Obtain the weapons they've requested and bring them to Merok Longstride outside of Hive'Regal.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something for me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work. We were in short supply of these, friend.
